title: Reviewed personal Hermes managed settings
description: Reviewed terminal, plugin and dashboard authentication policy from the pinned personal runtime. Other keys are preserved and explicitly unvalidated.

dashboard.description: Native authentication and the public URL are platform-owned; other dashboard settings are retained.

basic_auth.description: Native basic authentication is managed by the platform.

public_url.description: The public URL is managed by the platform.

oauth.description: Native OIDC configuration is managed by the platform.

terminal.description: Hermes terminal settings. The platform owns backend and the connection settings (manager_url, token_file, ca_file, ssh_key); other terminal keys are kept as given.

backend.description: Always managed_execution; the platform enforces it. Any other value is refused.

runtime_id.description: Pin the terminal backend by name for every profile, instead of letting users choose. The assignment must allow it, or terminal calls fail with no fallback.

plugins.description: Hermes plugin lists. The managed_execution plugin belongs to the platform: it cannot be disabled or configured here.

enabled.description: Names of the plugins to enable.

disabled.description: Names of plugins to switch off. A plugin named here is not loaded even if it is also listed in enabled.
